name: STA257H1 — Socratic Discovery (Measure-Theoretic Foundations)
description: Kolmogorov: (Ω,F,P). F = σ-algebra (closed under countable ops, contains Ω). P:F→[0,1] countably additive: P(∪Aᵢ)=ΣP(Aᵢ) for DISJOINT events. Required

steps.template_en: Kolmogorov: (Ω,F,P). F = σ-algebra (closed under countable ops, contains Ω). P:F→[0,1] countably additive: P(∪Aᵢ)=ΣP(Aᵢ) for DISJOINT events. Required for continuous distributions and infinite processes.
steps.template_zh: Kolmogorov概率空间(Ω,F,P)。F=σ-代数，P可数可加。连续分布和无穷过程需要测度论。

steps.template_en: Why can't we define P on EVERY subset of [0,1]? Vitali: partition [0,1] by x~y if x-y∈ℚ, pick one from each class → NON-MEASURABLE. Any P on ALL subsets can't be countably additive AND translation-invariant.
steps.template_zh: 为什么不能对[0,1]所有子集定义P？Vitali构造不可测集。所有子集上的概率不能同时可数可加和平移不变。

steps.template_en: Borel σ-algebra B(ℝ): smallest σ-algebra containing all open intervals. Contains 'nice' sets. |B(ℝ)| = c, |P(ℝ)| = 2^c. MOST subsets NOT Borel. Lebesgue measure λ extends to L(ℝ) ⊃ B(ℝ).
steps.template_zh: Borel σ-代数B(ℝ)：包含所有开区间的最小σ-代数。|B(ℝ)|=c, |P(ℝ)|=2^c。大多子集非Borel。

steps.template_en: Measurable function X:Ω→ℝ: ∀B Borel, X⁻¹(B)∈F. Distribution = pushforward μ_X(B)=P(X⁻¹(B)). Expectation E[X]=∫_Ω X dP = ∫_ℝ x dμ_X (Lebesgue integral). Handles 'spiky' functions.
steps.template_zh: 可测函数X:Ω→ℝ：每个Borel原像在F中。分布=前推测度。期望=Lebesgue积分。处理'尖刺'函数。

steps.template_en: Show: (1) If F is σ-algebra and A∈F, A^c∈F. (2) Intersection of σ-algebras is σ-algebra. (3) If X measurable, X², |X|, e^X measurable. (4) X+Y, XY, X/Y (Y≠0) measurable.
steps.template_zh: 证明：(1)若F是σ-代数且A∈F，则A^c∈F。(2)σ-代数的交是σ-代数。(3)若X可测，X²,|X|,e^X可测。

steps.template_en: Measure theory = FOUNDATION. Tells us what events are 'legal' (measurable). Provides Lebesgue integral. Cost: check measurability. Benefit: rigorous handling of infinite-dim processes (martingales, Brownian motion).
steps.template_zh: 测度论=基础。告诉我们什么事件'合法'(可测)。提供Lebesgue积分。代价：检查可测性。收益：严格处理无穷维过程。
